summary: Always-visible list of violet-option children for single or multiple selection.

usage.text: It is not form-associated and has no name attribute. Read the value property, or selectedValues in multiple mode, and submit it yourself.
With the multiple attribute, the selection is the selectedValues array property (no attribute) and value mirrors its first entry. Options marked selected seed it.
User selection fires input and change events with detail.value, plus detail.selectedValues in multiple mode. selectValue(v) and toggleValue(v) fire them too unless their second argument is false.

One tab stop. ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Home, End and type-ahead move the active option; Enter or Space selects it, or toggles it in multiple mode. The selection-follows-focus attribute selects while moving, in single mode only.

a11y.text: The label attribute is not rendered: it becomes the listbox's aria-label, falling back to an aria-label on the host and then to "Options". Provide one of them.
